title: Workout

max.hint_one: Stop with {{count}} rep in the tank.
max.hint_other: Stop with {{count}} reps in the tank.
max.none: No history yet, adjust if needed.

adjust.title: Adjust set {{set}}
adjust.stopHint: Pain, or equipment not available today

stop.title: Stop this exercise?
stop.purpose: Why? The reason shapes your next sessions.
stop.notePain_one: Set {{from}} is logged as pain. After the session you’ll choose what comes next: another exercise, lighter, or as it is.
stop.notePain_other: Sets {{from}} to {{to}} are logged as pain. After the session you’ll choose what comes next: another exercise, lighter, or as it is.
stop.noteNoEquipment_one: Set {{from}} is logged as no equipment. Your programme doesn’t change.
stop.noteNoEquipment_other: Sets {{from}} to {{to}} are logged as no equipment. Your programme doesn’t change.
stop.noteGroup: It’s dropped from the remaining rounds. The other exercises carry on.

timed.heldHint: Get into position, then tap. You get 3 s.
timed.thenRange: Then {{max}} s, aim for at least {{min}} s

warmup.skipRamp: Go straight to the work sets
warmup.rampShareOne: About {{pct}} % of {{kg}} kg, a single set to get the movement going
warmup.rampPlain: A light set to get the movement going

paused.title: Paused
paused.clock: of training so far, clock stopped

voiceOff: Voice cues off. Beeps stay on.

leave.title: Leave the session?
leave.done_one: {{count}} of {{total}} sets done. It is already saved.
leave.done_other: {{count}} of {{total}} sets done. They are already saved.
leave.pauseHint: Pick up where you left off from Programme
leave.finishHint: See the summary and choose whether it counts as done
leave.abandonHint: Sets done are kept; this session doesn’t count

abandon.title: Abandon the session?
abandon.body_one: Your set stays in your history, but the session doesn’t count: it will be offered again next time.
abandon.body_other: Your {{count}} sets stay in your history, but the session doesn’t count: it will be offered again next time.
abandon.bodyQuick_one: Your set stays in your history.
abandon.bodyQuick_other: Your {{count}} sets stay in your history.
abandon.bodyNone: No sets logged: the session is simply removed.

cooldown.offerGeneral: A few gentle stretches for the whole body.
cooldown.name: Cooldown
cooldown.title: Cooldown done
cooldown.calm: Nothing to log, nothing to change. Breathe out, drink some water.
cooldown.abandonBody: What you stretched stays in your history. Nothing else changes.

summary.title: Session done
summary.rampDone_one: Warm-up: the warm-up set is done. It isn’t counted in your work sets.
summary.rampDone_other: Warm-up: {{done}} of {{total}} warm-up sets done. They aren’t counted in your work sets.
summary.rampSkipped_one: Warm-up: the warm-up set was skipped.
summary.rampSkipped_other: Warm-up: the {{total}} warm-up sets were skipped.
summary.rampMixed_one: Warm-up: {{done}} of {{total}} warm-up sets done, {{skipped}} skipped. They aren’t counted in your work sets.
summary.rampMixed_other: Warm-up: {{done}} of {{total}} warm-up sets done, {{skipped}} skipped. They aren’t counted in your work sets.
summary.switchOn: Your rotation moves on to the next session.
summary.switchOff: This session will be offered again next time.
summary.quickNotice: Outside your programme: your rotation stays where it is.
summary.customNotice: Your own session, outside your programme: your rotation and your loads stay where they are.
summary.testSkipped: Max test skipped: nothing recorded. You can do it later from Progress, with Take a test.
summary.travelNotice: Travel kit: {{what}}. Your home loads stay where they are.
summary.travelOff: With your kit, less than half of the planned session: it will be offered again.
summary.travelList: With your kit, nothing moves for your home sessions.
summary.testHeldReentry: No max test this session: you’re easing back in after a long break. Do it from Progress, with Take a test, whenever you like.
summary.testHeldTravel: No max test with your travel kit. Do it from Progress, with Take a test, when you’re back.

resume.startedYesterday: Started yesterday at {{time}}. Finish it to keep the sets you logged.
resume.startedOn: Started on {{date}} at {{time}}. Finish it to keep the sets you logged.
resume.startedToday: Started at {{time}}. Finish it to keep the sets you logged.

open.title: A session is already open
open.body_one: {{open}} isn’t finished ({{done}} of {{total}} sets). Resume it, or abandon it to start {{next}}.
open.body_other: {{open}} isn’t finished ({{done}} of {{total}} sets). Resume it, or abandon it to start {{next}}.
open.bodyStale: {{open}} was left open. Finish it to keep its sets, then {{next}} starts.

test.kickerFirst: End-of-cycle max test, before the session

rule.oneSet: One set, as many reps as you can.
rule.oneTry: One attempt, as long as you can.
rule.stop: Stop at failure, when your form breaks, or at 50.
rule.stopClock: Stop the clock as soon as your form breaks. It stops on its own at 3:00.
rule.count: Count your reps: you enter them right after.

test.restHint: 3 min of rest first, so you test fresh.
test.thenWhy: Every session of the week works your {{muscles}}, so the test comes first, while you're fresh.
test.countHint: Count in your head. You enter the total right after.
test.holdKicker: Max test, the clock counts up
test.firstHold: First test: hold as long as you can.
test.entryNote: Starts at your last test. Only clean reps count; if unsure, enter the lower number.
test.entryNoteFirst: Only clean reps count; if unsure, enter the lower number.
test.entryNoteHold: Starts at your last test. Time stops when your form breaks; if unsure, enter the lower time.
test.entryNoteHoldFirst: Time stops when your form breaks; if unsure, enter the lower time.
test.moreCycle_one: {{amount}} more than at the end of cycle {{n}}
test.moreCycle_other: {{amount}} more than at the end of cycle {{n}}
test.moreFresh_one: {{amount}} more than your last fresh test
test.moreFresh_other: {{amount}} more than your last fresh test
test.less_one: {{amount}} fewer… Fatigue, sleep, a lighter week: a test varies from one time to the next.
test.less_other: {{amount}} fewer… Fatigue, sleep, a lighter week: a test varies from one time to the next.
test.firstSession: First end-of-cycle test: it's your baseline.
test.firstFresh: First fresh test: it's your baseline.
test.feeds: It adjusts your goal on this exercise for cycle {{next}}. Your tests are in Progress.
test.feedsFresh: The result can raise your goal, never lower it.
test.skipBody: Nothing is recorded for this test, and your session is still saved. You can do it any time from Progress, with Take a test.
test.blockedBody: This movement hurt recently, so a test to the limit isn't safe yet. It opens again after 2 pain-free sessions.
test.stopPurpose: Only for pain. What you did so far is kept, but it isn't shown as a result.
test.painStopped: Test stopped, nothing counted as a result
test.painNote: Nothing is recorded as a result.

fresh.title: Test done
fresh.notice: Outside your programme: your rotation and loads don't move. A fresh test is only compared with fresh tests.
fresh.warmup: Warm up first: a few easy sets of the movement, then start.

record.sub: Your best set on each of these exercises so far.
